id: LN2D: in-place holding versus information latency and noise, varied independently on the same controller (final controller; the true push force, delayed by L and with white noise sigma per axis, replaces the estimate in the whole hold-first decision: entry, ankle target, release prediction and force bound)
registered: 2026-10-28, before any LN2D run. Motivation: external review (latency x noise map); BUD2 varied latency only and acted on the entry only
grid: L in {0, 10, 20, 40} ms x sigma in {0, 5, 10, 20} N (16 conditions), plus the final controller with IMU-SME as reference
cells: 0.2 s pushes y +-70, x +-50, xy +-50 N (near the in-place boundary)
outcome: zero-step hold = failure is None and no step; also held and steps

predictions.N1 latency: for each sigma, zero-step holds non-increasing in L (tolerance 1 between neighbours) and L=0 >= L=40 + 4
predictions.N2 noise: for each L, zero-step holds non-increasing in sigma (tolerance 1 between neighbours)
predictions.reported: the 4 x 4 map of zero-step holds, held runs and steps; the position of the IMU-SME reference relative to the map
